integrity.proof_basis: Exact Catalan polygon-cutting factorial moments, uniform Catalan asymptotics, and a convergent beta-integral series.
integrity.reproduction: python check.py; 106 exact assertions passed on the delivered source.

limitations: Only two independent uniformly chosen triangulations of the same convex polygon.
Only small-side diagonal indices of square-root order, bounded away from zero after rescaling.
First and second moments and covariance functional only; no full weak distribution or absolute priority certification.
title: Universal \(8/\pi-1\) overdispersion of mesoscopic diagonals shared by two random triangulations
